edits.content:
### Validate required information before searching
Before calling a search tool, check its required parameters against the full conversation. If required dates are missing, do not invent dates from examples or defaults and do not make a partial search; use one `seek_information` call to ask only for the missing required information. When the user adds criteria for one domain, do not repeat unrelated searches that are already complete or available in cache.
